mapper.select: select conversation_id conversationId,user_id userId,role_code roleCode,title,status,last_message_time lastMessageTime from biz_ai_conversation where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and role_code=#{roleCode} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update biz_ai_message set content=#{content} where message_id=#{messageId}
update biz_ai_run set execution_mode=#{executionMode} where run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: select a.action_request_id actionRequestId,a.run_id runId,a.conversation_id conversationId, a.user_id userId,a.action_code actionCode,a.risk_level riskLevel, a.action_payload_json actionPayloadJson,a.confirmation_summary confirmationSummary, a.status,a.expire_time expireTime,a.result_json resultJson,r.trace_id traceId from biz_ai_action_request a join biz_ai_run r on r.run_id=a.run_id where a.action_request_id=#{actionRequestId} and a.user_id=#{userId}

select a.action_request_id actionRequestId,a.run_id runId,a.conversation_id conversationId, a.user_id userId,a.action_code actionCode,a.status,a.result_json resultJson, a.action_payload_json actionPayloadJson,a.create_time createTime from biz_ai_action_request a where a.conversation_id=#{conversationId} and a.user_id=#{userId} and a.action_code=#{actionCode} and a.status='EXECUTED' order by a.action_request_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update biz_ai_action_request set status='CONFIRMED',confirmed_user_id=#{userId}, confirmed_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where action_request_id=#{actionRequestId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING' and (expire_time is null or expire_time>sysdate())

update biz_ai_action_request set status='REJECTED',confirmed_user_id=#{userId}, confirmed_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where action_request_id=#{actionRequestId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING' and (expire_time is null or expire_time>sysdate())
update biz_ai_action_request set status='SUPERSEDED',update_time=sysdate() where action_request_id=#{actionRequestId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING'
update biz_ai_action_request set status='EXECUTED',executed_time=sysdate(), result_json=#{resultJson},update_time=sysdate() where action_request_id=#{actionRequestId} and status='CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: select workflow_id workflowId,conversation_id conversationId,user_id userId,role_code roleCode, workflow_code workflowCode,workflow_status workflowStatus,current_step currentStep,draft_json draftJson, missing_fields_json missingFieldsJson,bound_entities_json boundEntitiesJson,version_no versionNo, action_request_id actionRequestId,expire_time expireTime,update_time updateTime from biz_ai_workflow_instance where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and workflow_status in ('COLLECTING','READY','WAITING_CONFIRMATION') and (expire_time is null or expire_time>sysdate()) order by workflow_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update biz_ai_workflow_instance set workflow_status=#{workflowStatus},current_step=#{currentStep}, draft_json=#{draftJson},missing_fields_json=#{missingFieldsJson},bound_entities_json=#{boundEntitiesJson}, action_request_id=#{actionRequestId},version_no=version_no+1,update_time=sysdate() where workflow_id=#{workflowId} and user_id=#{userId} and version_no=#{versionNo} and workflow_status in ('COLLECTING','READY','WAITING_CONFIRMATION')

update biz_ai_workflow_instance set workflow_status=#{workflowStatus},action_request_id=#{actionRequestId}, version_no=version_no+1,completed_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and user_id=#{userId} and workflow_code=#{workflowCode} and workflow_status in ('COLLECTING','READY','WAITING_CONFIRMATION')
